title: HB 387 (2021-2022 (134th General Assembly)): H. B. No. 387: Make changes to election laws
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) When an elector appears in a polling place to vote, the elector shall announce to the precinct election officials the elector's full name and current address and provide proof of the elector's identity in the form of a photo identification or a United States passport that is not expired.
(section) R.C. 3501.01(AA)(3)
(quote) It is one of the following documents: (a) An Ohio driver's license or Ohio commercial driver's license issued by the registrar of motor vehicles or deputy registrar under Chapter 4507. of the Revised Code that shows the current or former address of the elector, regardless of whether that address conforms to the address in the individual's voter registration record, and that is not expired; (b) A state identification card issued by the registrar of motor vehicles or deputy registrar under section 4507.50 of the Revised Code that shows the current or former address of the elector ... and that is not expired; (c) An Ohio driver's license ... or a state identification card ... that is expired and a United States military identification card that is not expired
(section) R.C. 3501.01(AA)
(quote) STRUCK: (5) It was issued by the government of the United States or this state
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(2)
(quote) If an elector does not have or is unable to provide photo identification or a United States passport that is not expired to the precinct election officials because the elector has a religious objection to being photographed, the elector may execute an affirmation under penalty of election falsification to that effect and cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(3)
(quote) If an elector does not have or is unable to provide photo identification, as defined in division (AA) of section 3501.01 of the Revised Code, or a United States passport that is not expired to the precinct election officials but does not have a religious objection to being photographed, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code and do either of the following: (a) Write the elector's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number or the last four digits of the elector's social security number on the provisional ballot envelope; or (b) Appear at the office of the board of elections not later than the seventh day after the day of the election and provide photo identification, the elector's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number, or the last four digits of the elector's social security number.
(section) R.C. 4507.50(C)
(quote) A person seventeen years of age or older may apply to the registrar or a deputy registrar for the issuance to that person of an identification card or a temporary identification card under this section without payment of any fee prescribed in division (B) of this section.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) R.C. 3509.03(B)(5)(a)-(b)
(quote) The elector's photo identification or a United States passport that is not expired, if the elector will be marking absent voter's ballots in person at the office of the board of elections; (b) If the elector will not be marking the ballots in person, all of the following: (i) The elector's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number and the expiration date of the driver's license or state identification card; (ii) The last four digits of the elector's social security number; (iii) A copy of the front and back of an elector's photo identification.
(section) R.C. 3509.03(B)(5)
(quote) STRUCK: , a copy of a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document, other than a notice of voter registration mailed by a board of elections under section 3503.19 of the Revised Code, that shows the name and address of the elector
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) R.C. 3503.14(A)(5)
(quote) The voter to provide all of the following: (a) The voter's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number; (b) The last four digits of the voter's social security number; (c) A copy of the front and back of a photo identification.
(section) R.C. 3503.14 (return in person)
(quote) A registration, change of residence, or change of name form returned in person shall include a copy of the front and back of the person's photo identification. If a person other than the person for whom the registration, change of residence, or change of name form is for returns the registration or form, that person shall also show the person's photo identification to the officials or employees.
(section) R.C. 4507.41(B)
(quote) The registrar of motor vehicles shall ensure that the distinguishing number on a commercial driver's license, driver's license, temporary instruction permit, or identification card is arranged as follows: (1) For any holder that is a citizen of the United States, the letters appear before the numbers. (2) For any holder that is not a citizen of the United States, the numbers appear before the letters.
(other) 3501.11, 3503.10, 3503.11: boards, agencies and the BMV must give free copies of photo ID for registration forms
(other) 3503.16: movers/name changers vote provisional ballot instead of showing ID
(other) 3503.19, 3503.28: registration notice wording on ID and religious objection
(other) 3503.20: online registration adds upload of photo ID front and back
(other) 3505.181-3505.183: provisional ballot rules adjusted to photo ID and religious objection affirmation
(other) 3509.04: absentee envelope statement adds in-person photo ID statement and licence expiry date
(other) 3506.21: rules on interpreting errant in-person ballot markings
(other) 4507.50: state ID card free to anyone 17+ (was disabled veterans/unemployed); 4507.502 (new): BMV reimbursement for free ID cards; 4507.41 (new): licence number format by citizenship
(other) note: Photo-ID-at-polls bill; sole version. The wording 'identification' in R.C. 3505.18(A)(1) follows the new definition of 'photo identification' in 3501.01(AA). Ellipses in the 3501.01(AA)(3) quote mark omitted repeated words, not omitted rules.
